unrealtrainmod.configuration.sortTranslu: Enabled by default. Disabling only skips vehicle translucent triangle sorting; depth calculation, index uploads and adjacent draw merging remain active. Ignored while static translucent batches are enabled. Applies to world and preview rendering. Overlapping translucent surfaces may blend incorrectly when disabled.
unrealtrainmod.configuration.useStaticTr: Disabled by default. Draws static translucent batches in submission order, skipping triangle collection, depth calculation, sorting and dynamic index uploads on the GPU path. Overrides translucent triangle sorting. Applies to world and preview rendering. Overlapping translucent surfaces may blend incorrectly.
